source.title: [DDV KATEHEZE] Zašto ići na ispovijed ako ćeš opet sagriješiti? - pater Sebastian Šujević

summary.title_hr: [DDV KATEHEZE] Zašto ići na ispovijed ako ćeš opet sagriješiti? - pater Sebastian Šujević
summary.abstract_hr: U katehezi u sklopu Duhovno duhovitih večeri pater Sebastian Šujević govori o sakramentu ispovijedi kao dubokom susretu sa živim Bogom. Polazi od prispodobe o milosrdnom Ocu, mlađem i starijem sinu te pokazuje kako se u ljudskom srcu odvijaju različite borbe s grijehom. Odbacuje izgovor da nema smisla ići na ispovijed ako će čovjek opet sagriješiti, jer bit nije u tome da se ide sam, nego s Isusom. Navodi korake dobre ispovijedi: vjeru u oproštenje, praštanje drugima, odricanje od grijeha i želju za slobodom. Tumači formulu odrješenja, iznosi osobna iskustva i primjere oslobođenja te završava čitanjem Psalma 103.
key_points: Ispovijed je sažetak prispodobe o milosrdnom Ocu: mlađi sin pokazuje dinamičnu i divlju borbu, a stariji sin hladnu i proračunatu pasivnost, i svatko od nas prolazi faze obojice.
Misao 'zašto se ispovijedati kad ću opet sagriješiti' je zamka i varka. Sam čovjek će ponovno pasti, ali bit je da sljedeći put ide s Isusom, jer je Gospodinu moguće ono što čovjeku nije.
Prepreke koje se pojave kad se čovjek odluči na ispovijed, poput poziva na kavu, obaveza ili lošeg vremena, znak su da je to pravi trenutak susreta s Ocem.
Za dobru ispovijed potrebno je vjerovati da Bog sve oprašta, oprostiti drugima i tražiti oprost, iskreno se odreći grijeha i doći po svoju slobodu kao dijete Božje.
U formuli odrješenja Duh Sveti obnavlja krsnu milost i daruje se mir, koji znači slobodu, iscjeljenje i osnaživanje za životni put i nošenje križa.

Govornik svjedoči da je najviše milosti dobio u ispovijedi. Navodi i primjere ljudi koji su se nakon dobre pripreme i ispovijedi oslobodili ovisnosti te mladića koji je pronašao mir nakon iskustva prizivanja duhova.
Gospodin je u sakramentu potpuno prisutan, neovisno o raspoloženju vjernika, pa mu treba donijeti svoje pouzdanje i sve što nas opterećuje.
key_points_en: Confession is a summary of the parable of the merciful Father: the younger son shows a dynamic and wild struggle, and the older son a cold and calculated passivity, and each of us goes through phases of both.

The thought 'why confess when I will sin again' is a trap and a deception. Man alone will fall again, but the point is that next time he goes with Jesus, because what is not possible for man is possible for the Lord.
Obstacles that appear when a person decides to go to confession, such as an invitation for coffee, obligations, or bad weather, are a sign that this is the right moment of encounter with the Father.
For a good confession, it is necessary to believe that God forgives everything, to forgive others and seek forgiveness, sincerely renounce sin, and come for one's freedom as a child of God.
In the formula of absolution, the Holy Spirit renews the baptismal grace and peace is bestowed, which means freedom, healing, and strengthening for the path of life and carrying the cross.

The speaker testifies that he received the most grace in confession. He also cites examples of people who, after good preparation and confession, were freed from addiction, and a young man who found peace after the experience of summoning spirits.
The Lord is completely present in the sacrament, regardless of the mood of the believer, so one should bring Him their trust and everything that burdens us.
summary.title_en: [DDV CATECHESES] Why go to confession if you will sin again? - Father Sebastian Šujević
summary.abstract_en: In the catechesis within Duhovno-duhovite večeri, Father Sebastian Šujević speaks about the sacrament of confession as a profound encounter with the living God. He starts from the parable of the merciful Father, the younger and the older son, and shows how different struggles with sin take place in the human heart. He rejects the excuse that there is no point in going to confession if a person will sin again, because the point is not to go alone, but with Jesus. He lists the steps of a good confession: faith in forgiveness, forgiving others, renouncing sin, and the desire for freedom. He explains the formula of absolution, presents personal experiences and examples of liberation, and concludes with the reading of Psalm 103.
